source.title: Influence of Sex, Age, and Weight on Levetiracetam Pharmacokinetics.

items.quote: Sex is a conditioning factor of LEV CL/F, although its influence is principally due to the weight.
items.claim: A retrospective levetiracetam study attributed much of the sex-related clearance difference to weight.
items.relevance: Clinical covariates are context, not proof about the fictional compound or its simulated mechanism.
limitations: Real published class-context evidence; not a study of the simulated compound.
Prepared annotation of a captured abstract excerpt; human review required.

source.title: Population pharmacokinetics of levetiracetam in Japanese and Western adults.

items.quote: Bodyweight, sex, creatinine clearance and concomitant intake of enzyme inducers or valproic acid had a statistically significant effect on apparent plasma clearance of levetiracetam.
items.claim: A population PK study identified several covariates associated with levetiracetam clearance.
items.study_design: Population PK analysis of pooled clinical studies
items.relevance: This study also identified sex as a covariate. Do not infer no sex effect, equivalence or causality from a different drug.
limitations: Real published class-context evidence; not a study of the simulated compound.
Prepared annotation of a captured abstract excerpt; human review required.
